L.intro: You will hear a short conversation between two neighbours. Then answer one question.
lines: Hamid, are you heading to the recycling depot this weekend? I have a pile of cardboard boxes from the move.
I was planning to go Saturday morning, but they just changed the hours. It is closed on Saturdays until the end of the month.
Sunday works. I can take your boxes if you flatten them first, otherwise they will not fit in my hatchback.

q.q: What does Hamid ask Gloria to do?
o: Drive the boxes to the depot herself
Wait until the end of the month
q.ev: I can take your boxes if you flatten them first

R.meta: Notice posted in the lobby of Maple Court Apartments
R.text:
Water Shut-off – Tuesday

The water supply to all units on floors 3 to 6 will be turned off on Tuesday from 9:00 a.m. to approximately 1:00 p.m. while a leaking pipe is replaced. Residents on floors 1 and 2 are not affected. Please store some drinking water the night before. If the work finishes early, the water will be restored without further notice.

q.q: What are residents on the fourth floor advised to do?
o: Save drinking water on Monday evening
Report leaks to the building manager
Wait for a second notice before using water
q.ev: Please store some drinking water the night before
